metadata.resolved_prompt:
Locate and transcribe the large letter on every visible letter tile.

Use one tight box around each letter, not the tile boundary; keep adjacent tiles separate. Include rotated letters; exclude point values, blank tiles and background text. Return plain text, not LaTeX.

Use tight, axis-aligned boxes. Include rotated text. Preserve printed characters, capitalization and punctuation; do not infer missing characters or translate. Use null for visible but unreadable text. Return entries top-to-bottom, then left-to-right. If none are visible, return [].  Return valid JSON without explanations or Markdown.

Return only a valid JSON array with this structure:
[{"box_2d": [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max], "text": "..."}]

Use coordinates normalized from 0 to 1000 relative to the image dimensions.

Use exactly the keys shown. Use text, never label, for transcription. Do not include explanations or Markdown.

Receipt number: prefer Bill/Invoice/Receipt, then Check/CHK, then transaction/order ID; exclude terminal, table, payment and unlabeled barcode numbers.
